articles.summary: Santiago, February 3, 2026 – LATAM Airlines Group today announced its financial and operational results for the fourth quarter and full year 2025, reporting a solid performance and profitable growth. During the year, the group posted net income of US$1.5 billion, representing a 49.4% increase compared to 2024, and transported 87.4 million passengers, consolidating its position as the largest airline group in the Southern Hemisphere. In 2025, LATAM achieved total operating revenues of US$14.5 bil
articles.title: LATAM Airlines Group closes 2025 with net income of US$1.5 billion and more than 87 million passengers transported
